---
title: "Local rules and specialist help"
---

Some questions need an answer from someone who knows your project or university. Use this page to find a starting point.

## Who to ask {#who-decides-what}

| You need help with… | Start with… |
|---|---|
| Deadlines, leave, examination or complaints procedures | Your graduate research office and current university rules. |
| Permission to start or change a study | The office or person responsible for the relevant ethics, site, safety, community or data approval. |
| Study design, sampling or analysis | Your supervisor or a methods specialist, with the research literature and your proposed approach. |
| Storing, sharing or deleting research data | Your data custodian or research data service. Bring the consent terms and project agreements. |
| Software or AI use with research material | Your research or IT service. Check the tool's terms and your project, funder and publisher requirements. |
| Authorship or publication | Your co-authors and supervisor. Check the authorship standard, publisher requirements and any copyright or partner agreements. |
| Records and access after the project ends | Your research office and data custodian, including any funder, partner or community commitments. |

When an answer affects an approval, submission or irreversible action, keep the advice and its date with your project records.

## If you need confidential support {#when-someone-may-be-harmed}

For concerns about wellbeing, unsafe work, harassment, misconduct or a data breach, use [Getting support](stuck/wellbeing-or-safety.qmd). It explains who to contact and what to prepare. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
